description: Hitachi Energy (ABB) REx5xx REL511 distance zones as a flat REL511 setting sheet prints them (TAP NAME | TAP SETTING | TAP RANGE). Catalog-only. Configured settings: per-zone Operation_Zn (status), DirZn (direction), gated Timer tn / tn, X1Zn (reactive reach), R1Zn, X0Zn / R0Zn, the CT / VT values and the line data. Documented relay behaviour (DEC-198, verified): the fixed X/R polygonal (quadrilateral) characteristic and the full-scheme phase-phase / phase-earth loops of every enabled zone (ABB 1MDB06309-YN; REL511 exposes no selector for either), secondary-ohm impedance settings and RFNZn as the phase-earth fault-resistance reach in ohm/loop (ABB REL 511 2.3 / 2.5 manuals). Not verified (blocking): ZnBlock = On on an enabled zone. Not representable (blocking): RFZn's inclined phase-phase resistive boundary (documented, preserved, not plotted) and the left / directional boundary.
interpretation_notes: Zone N is the parameter set ending in ZN (Operation_ZN, X1ZN, R1ZN, X0ZN, R0ZN, RFZN, RFNZN, Timer tN, tN, DirZN, ZNBlock); the numbering follows the sheet.

Documented relay behaviour (ABB 1MDB06309-YN, Line distance protection terminal REL 511): every enabled distance zone has the fixed X/R polygonal (quadrilateral) characteristic and measures the phase-phase and phase-earth loops (full scheme). The reference applies to the REL 511 / REx 5xx distance function by its matching function and parameter structure, not to a confirmed firmware revision.
A 'V<n>' marker in the scheme name is not established as the firmware version (it may be a scheme / template version), so no firmware version is asserted.

Documented relay behaviour (ABB REL 511 2.3 / 2.5 manuals 1MRK 506 101-UEN, 109-UEN, 167-UEN): the impedance settings are secondary ohms; X1Zn / R1Zn / X0Zn / R0Zn are ohm/phase; RFZn is the phase-phase and RFNZn the phase-earth fault-resistance reach, both ohm/loop. Verified for the REL 511 family (2.3 generation); likely but version-dependent for this 1.x-style setting format; no firmware match is claimed. Never inferred from the CT / VT ratios.

Documented phase-phase geometry (per-phase R-X plane, forward zone): top X <= X1Zn; right R <= R1Zn * X / X1Zn + RFZn / 2; left R >= R1Zn * X / X1Zn - RFZn / 2 -- resistive lines inclined at atan(X1Zn / R1Zn), crossing the R axis at +/- RFZn / 2. Directional lines: ArgDir in the fourth quadrant (5-45 deg below the R axis) and ArgNegRes in the second quadrant (90-175 deg from the R axis), common to all zones and not on this sheet; a reverse zone is the forward characteristic rotated 180 deg.

Documented phase-earth geometry (loop domain): reactive reach (2 * X1Zn + X0Zn) / 3; resistive reach at the zone end (2 * R1Zn + R0Zn) / 3 + RFNZn, lines inclined at atan((2 * X1Zn + X0Zn) / (2 * R1Zn + R0Zn)). Not drawn by the phase-phase engine.
Not yet verified: what ZnBlock = On does on an enabled zone. Its value is preserved and blocks; it is not read as a permanent block or as power-swing blocking.

Geometry limitation: the current engine draws vertical resistive limits and cannot represent the inclined resistive lines or the directional lines, so no Right (+R) or Left (-R) Resistive Reach is plotted. No approximation is applied.

zone_preserved.reason: ZnBlock is an On / Off switch whose effect (what it blocks) is not verified; its value is preserved and never interpreted as a zone state.

mappings.note: CTPrim Iphases: the phase CT primary current (no unit printed; amperes).
Ir is the relay's rated current input; it is taken as the CT secondary rating. The sheet does not label it as the CT secondary (the notes' CT ratio agrees). Confirm.
VTPrim Uphases is printed without a unit; kV is assumed (the sheet's 132kV header agrees) and converted to volts. Confirm the unit.
Ur is the relay's rated voltage input; it is taken as the VT secondary rating (volts). The sheet does not label it as the VT secondary. Confirm.
Line Length as printed; its unit is the sheet's 'Length unit'.
Length unit as printed (not converted).
R1 / X1 of the line-data group (beside Line Length and the fault-locator source impedances) read as the line's positive-sequence impedance; the sheet's own '1' / '0' naming, not a stated label.
R0 / X0 of the line-data group read as the line's zero-sequence impedance; the sheet's own '1' / '0' naming, not a stated label.
The zone's own Operation switch.
DirZn as printed. A value that is not one of the printed options (Non / Forward / Reverse) is not interpreted.

REL 511 impedance settings are secondary ohms: the setting procedure converts the primary line impedances to the CT / VT secondary side (ABB 1MRK 506 109-UEN, Eq. 39), and the reach setting ranges are stated for the rated current Ir = 1 A, all impedance values divided by 5 for Ir = 5 A (ABB 1MRK 506 101-UEN, 1.10). Verified for the REL 511 2.3 generation; likely but version-dependent for this setting format. Not inferred from the CT / VT ratios or from the magnitude of any value.

mappings.note: REL 511 distance zones have a fixed X/R polygonal (quadrilateral) characteristic (ABB 1MDB06309-YN, Fig. 1, pp. 2-3), applied to an enabled zone. The relay adjusts the operate characteristic to the line characteristic angle (resistive lines inclined at atan(X1Zn / R1Zn)); the current engine does not reproduce that inclination.

not_exposed.note: REL511 has no characteristic selector: the X/R polygonal characteristic of its distance zones is fixed relay behaviour.

mappings.note: X1Zn: the zone's positive-sequence reactive reach.

R1Zn: the zone's positive-sequence resistance setting (ohm/phase). It sets the inclination of the zone's resistive lines (atan(X1Zn / R1Zn); ABB 1MRK 506 109-UEN, Eq. 31-37); the current engine draws vertical resistive limits, so it does not set a drawn boundary.
R0Zn / X0Zn: the zone's zero-sequence reach (ohm/phase), used by the relay for its phase-earth loop reach (earth-return compensation computed by the relay). Preserved, not plotted.

gap.note: The source phase-phase fault-resistance setting ({evidence}) is documented: RFZ{n} is the zone's phase-phase fault-resistance reach in ohm/loop. Its per-phase R-X boundary is inclined, below the reactance limit X <= X1Z{n}: Rright(X) = R1Z{n} * X / X1Z{n} + RFZ{n} / 2 and Rleft(X) = R1Z{n} * X / X1Z{n} - RFZ{n} / 2. The current engine draws only vertical resistive limits and cannot represent this boundary, so no Right Resistive Reach (+R) is plotted; the source value is preserved here.

No left (-R) resistive reach is stated as a number. The documented left boundary of an enabled zone is the inclined line R = R1Z{n} * X / X1Z{n} - RFZ{n} / 2 together with the directional lines (ArgDir in the fourth quadrant, ArgNegRes in the second; a reverse zone is the forward characteristic rotated 180 deg), whose angles this sheet does not state. The current engine cannot represent it; no left boundary is drawn or approximated.

mappings.note: RFNZn is the zone's phase-earth fault-resistance reach in ohm/loop, a loop-domain quantity: the phase-earth loop's resistive reach at the zone end is (2 * R1Zn + R0Zn) / 3 + RFNZn, with lines inclined at atan((2 * X1Zn + X0Zn) / (2 * R1Zn + R0Zn)) (ABB 1MRK 506 109-UEN, Eq. 24-28, 69-70). Kept as printed: it is not halved and not converted into a phase-phase reach. The phase-phase engine does not draw it.
